svg.title: Exposed BOM Managed Artifact Map
svg.desc: Managed artifactId map rebuilt from the exposed-bom README and java-platform Gradle constraints.
svg.text: Import-only Gradle java-platform BOM: dependencyManagement constraints for published artifactIds; no runtime classes.

g.text: Import bluetape4k-exposed-bom once, then declare managed bluetape4k-exposed-* dependencies without per-module versions.
Examples, demo apps, and benchmark modules stay outside the published BOM constraints.
